P.name: Essence Theft
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Ahri''' generates a {{tip|stack}} of ''Essence Fragment'' whenever she kills a {{tip|minion}} or {{tip|monster}}. At 9 stacks, she consumes them to {{tip|heal}} herself for {{pplevel|35 to 95|color=heal}} {{as|(+ 20% AP)}}.
P.description2: Additionally, whenever '''Ahri''' scores a champion {{tip|takedown}} within 3 seconds of damaging them, she consumes their essence to heal herself for {{pplevel|75 to 165|color=heal}} {{as|(+ 30% AP)}}.

Q.name: Orb of Deception
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ahri''' sends her orb in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies it passes through. Upon reaching maximum range, it returns to her to deal the same amount in {{sti|{{as|true damage}}}} to enemies it passes through.
Q.leveling: {{st|Damage Per Pass|{{ap|35 to 135}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}}|Total Mixed Damage|{{ap|35*2 to 135*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|50*2}}% AP)}}}}
Q.description2: ''Enemies can be hit only once per pass.''

W.name: Fox-Fire
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ahri''' gains {{sti|{{as|40% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} that decays over 2 seconds and conjures three flames which orbit her clockwise for up to {{fd|2.5}} seconds.
W.description2: After {{fd|0.25}} seconds of the cast, each flame targets a {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy based on priority, or after {{fd|0.4}} seconds, simply targets the closest visible enemy in range. Each flame deals {{as|magic damage}}, with subsequent flames against a target dealing 40% damage.
W.leveling2: {{st|Primary Magic Damage|{{ap|40 to 120}} {{as|(+ 40% AP)}}|Subsequent Magic Damage|{{ap|40*0.4 to 120*0.4}} {{as|(+ {{ap|40*0.4}}% AP)}}|Total Single-Target Damage|{{ap|40*(1+0.4*2) to 120*(1+0.4*2)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|40*(1+0.4*2)}}% AP)}}}}
W.description3: Flames prioritize enemy champions hit by ''{{ai|Charm|Ahri}}'', then enemy {{tip|champion|champions}}, then minions that would die to ''Fox-Fire's'' damage, and then the target of '''Ahri's''' last basic attack within 3 seconds.
W.description4: ''Fox-Fire's'' damage is doubled against {{tip|minions}} below {{sti|{{as|20% '''maximum''' health}}}}.
W.leveling4: {{st|Primary Minion Damage|{{ap|40*2 to 120*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|40*2}}% AP)}}|Subsequent Minion Damage|{{ap|40*2*0.4 to 120*2*0.4}} {{as|(+ {{ap|40*2*0.4}}% AP)}}}}

E.name: Charm
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ahri''' blows forth a kiss in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit, {{tip|knockdown|knocking them down}} and {{tip|charm|charming}} and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 65% for a duration.
E.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|80 to 240}} {{as|(+ 85% AP)}}}}
{{st|Disable Duration|{{ap|1.2 to 1.8}} seconds}}

R.name: Spirit Rush
R.description:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Ahri''' {{tip|dashes}} to the target location and then fires essence bolts to up to 3 nearby {{tip|sight|visible}} enemies, each dealing {{as|magic damage}}.

''Spirit Rush'' can be recast twice more within 15 seconds of the activation at no additional cost, with a 1-second {{tt|static cooldown|Unaffected by ability haste}} between casts. Consuming a champion's essence with ''{{ai|Essence Theft|Ahri}}'' while ''Spirit Rush'' is active extends the recast duration by and up to 10 seconds, and grants an additional recast, storing up to 3 recasts at a time.
R.description3: ''Spirit Rush's recast duration will persist even after using all recasts. {{ai|Fox-Fire|Ahri}} can be cast during the dash.''
R.cooldown: {{tt|{{ap|140 to 100}}|Starts after first cast, and refreshes upon gaining recasts}}
